ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases and the efforts to combat it.
questions: What are the most common schemes used to commit Medicaid fraud?
How effective are current efforts to combat Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption, and to shed light on the need for increased oversight and accountability.
